name: Luciole-8B-Audio-1.0 (also 1B and 23B)

lineage.how_derived: speech-LLM: frozen Parakeet-TDT-0.6B-v3 Conformer encoder + linear adapter (1024 to 4096) with RoTE, LLM adapted with LoRA (r 64) on NeMo Speech (card)

purpose: European, sovereign audio-language model trained on the Jean Zay supercomputer (France 2030, BPI): ASR, speech translation, spoken QA, summarization, diarization, temporal localization, speaker/emotion/language recognition, sound and music captioning (card).

architecture.kind: speech LLM (SALM): frozen Parakeet-TDT encoder + audio adapter + Luciole-8B LLM with LoRA

strengths: French/English strongest; German, Spanish, Italian for ASR, AST and spoken QA
weaknesses: card: spoken QA mainly French and English; Arabic weak (FLEURS WER about 30%) because the frozen Parakeet v3 encoder never saw Arabic
soft.maturity: Public-funded consortium, 3 sizes; 1k downloads so far.

tona_fit.reason: An open audio-understanding LLM with German ASR/translation and a European provenance, built on the Parakeet encoder we already track. Evaluate against Voxtral and Qwen3-Omni-class audio models on German tasks before any offer.

open_questions: Evaluation figures are charts; German WER not extracted
